subject: general
question: _______ is often referred to as book of prime entry or the book of original entry.
solution:
The correct answer is** Journal.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Journal is often referred to as book of prime entry or the book of original entry:**

 
 
• The journal is the initial record where all financial transactions are first entered before they are posted to the ledger accounts. This is why it is called the book of original entry or prime entry.
 
• It captures the chronological sequence of transactions, ensuring that no transaction is overlooked or omitted.
 
• The journal includes details such as the date of the transaction, accounts affected, amounts, and a brief description, providing a comprehensive record of all business activities.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Book-keeping:**

 
 
• Book-keeping refers to the process of recording financial transactions systematically. While it involves the use of journals and ledgers, it is not specifically the book of original entry.
 
 
 
• **Ledger:**
 
 
• The ledger is a book or a collection of accounts where transactions from the journal are posted and categorized. It is not the first place of entry but rather a place for organizing and summarizing financial data.
 
 
 
• **Capital book:**
 
 
• The capital book is not a standard term in accounting. It might refer to records related to capital accounts, but it is not the book of original entry.
